page.layout: One printed page, cut off on the right. Heading across the top. Left column: the running text of the title paragraph. Right of it: a brace diagram with boxes whose text is cut off at the scan edge.; One page of synopsis: a header line across the top; two blocks of text at left, each with a "PARS" label; and two brace diagrams at right, with boxes running off the right edge.; One narrow strip of the page: text lines running down the right side of the scan, with a fragment of running text at the top of the strip. No columns, no notes in other margins.

page.notes: The right-hand part of the page is cut off, so the heading and the box labels end at the scan edge. Mirrored show-through from the other side of the leaf is left out. The reading "præsenti" is doubtful because of the overprint. Right-hand box labels run off the scan and are only partly legible; their fragments are marked [?]. The large decorative word "SYNOPSIS" above the header is largely illegible and is not transcribed. Faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored. Only the right-hand part of each line is visible on this strip; the left parts are cut off. Lines beginning with "AM", "ISPANIAM", "ALLIAM" and "ALIAM" are capitalised, widely spaced headings of map titles, transcribed as far as visible. The first line's opening word is lost in the cut. Several lines are partly illegible due to the scan edge.
